title_en: Record ETF Inflows, Industry M&A, and the Launch of a New Exchange
title_zh: ETF 流入创纪录、行业并购潮与新交易所上线——对话 VettaFi Todd Rosenbluth 与 Westwood Brian Casey
subtitle_zh: Todd Rosenbluth 盘点创纪录流入与并购潮，Brian Casey 详解首只登陆德州证券交易所的 PowerX ETF。
description: Record ETF Inflows, Industry M&A, and the Launch of a New Exchange

turns.en: You are correct. This has been a great year for Fixed Income ETFs. I will give you the first of many congratulations on getting this call right.
turns.zh: 你说得完全正确。今年是固定收益ETF（fixed income ETF）大放异彩的一年。就冲你这次预判精准，我要送上接下来无数声祝贺里的第一声。

turns.en: All right. Joining me will be Brian Casey, CEO of Westwood Holdings Group, which is a publicly traded investment and wealth management firm with about $18 billion in assets under management and advisement. That includes an ETF platform where they currently offer three ETFs, nearly $500 million in assets. They also have a partnership with Web's investments, who has another two ETFs. But tomorrow, Westwood is launching the Westwood
turns.zh: 好了。今天和我一起的嘉宾是 Westwood Holdings Group 的 CEO Brian Casey。Westwood 是一家上市的投资与财富管理公司，管理和顾问的资产规模约 180 亿美元。这里面也包括一个 ETF 平台，目前旗下有三只 ETF，资产规模近 5 亿美元。他们还与 Salient 有合作关系，对方另外有两只 ETF。但明天，Westwood 将推出 Westwood

turns.en: Salient Enhanced Power and Infrastructure ETF, ticker PWRX PowerX. And besides the ETF itself, what is noteworthy here is this will be the first ETF to launch on the brand new Texas Stock Exchange.
turns.zh: Salient Enhanced Power and Infrastructure ETF，代码 PWRX，简称 PowerX。而且除了 ETF 本身，值得关注的地方在于，这将是第一只在全新的德州证券交易所（Texas Stock Exchange）上市的 ETF。

turns.en: Texas, where live trading began back in July, but this will be the first ETF launch there. And so Brian and I are going to discuss the decision making behind launching and listing PowerX on this new exchange. I want to find out what he thinks taxi means for the ETF industry overall and what it means for the state of Texas. And then we will certainly get into that ETF and the Westwood ETF platform overall. This should be a great conversation with Brian, who he's been CEO
turns.zh: 德州证券交易所 7 月就已经开始实盘交易，但这将是它的首只 ETF 上线。所以 Brian 和我将讨论把 PowerX 在这家新交易所发行和上市背后的决策过程。我想听听他怎么看 TSE 对整个 ETF 行业、对德州意味着什么。然后我们当然也会聊这只 ETF 本身，以及 Westwood 的 ETF 平台整体。这将是一场和 Brian 的精彩对话，他担任

turns.en: at Westwood for over two decades. So no shortage of experience and perspective that he can provide on all of that. Now to start this week, I'll be joined by Todd Rosenbluth, head of research at Betify. And we are going to bounce around on some recent ETF industry milestones and news and events. There's been a lot going on in this space recently, as there always is. And so we thought it'd be fun to catch you up on some of the big stories and offer up our hot takes. And then Todd
turns.zh: Westwood 的 CEO 已经超过二十年，所有这些话题上都不缺经验和视角。本周开篇，我首先会邀请 VettaFi 的研究主管 Todd Rosenbluth，我们会就近期 ETF 行业的一些里程碑、新闻和事件七嘴八舌聊一聊。最近这个行业一直热闹如常，所以我们想带大家回顾几条大新闻，也亮出我们的热点观点。之后 Todd

turns.en: was also going to spend a few minutes looking ahead to the remainder of the year. As always, questions or comments you can find me on X at Nate Geracy or you can go to etfprime.com.
turns.zh: 还会花几分钟展望今年剩下的时间。老规矩，有任何问题或意见，可以在 X 上找我，账号是 Nate Geraci，也可以访问 etfprime.com。

turns.en: So first up is the one and only Todd Rosenbluth with Betify, who is joining me from New York. Todd, always great having you on the podcast. It is great to be here. And this might be the first time I've ever been on with you, where the Giants have the same record as the Kansas City Chiefs.
turns.zh: 首先有请独一无二的、来自 VettaFi 的 Todd Rosenbluth，他从纽约连线。Todd，很高兴你又上节目。——我也很高兴来到这里。这可能是我第一次上你节目，巨人队（Giants）和堪萨斯城酋长队（Chiefs）的战绩居然一样。

turns.en: Don't expect that to last. I think the Chiefs are back in business. We have a running back now, and we have a healthy Mahomes. So I'm feeling pretty good about our chances.
turns.zh: 别指望这局面能维持多久。我觉得酋长队已经缓过来了，现在我们有了跑卫，Mahomes 也伤愈健康，所以我对我们的机会挺乐观。

turns.en: Listen, the Giants are tied for first place in their division. I'll take it as a victory. All right. So I know people aren't here to hear our sports takes because mine are probably pretty bad. So let's offer up some of our ETF takes. And as I know that we are going to bounce around on a number of recent ETF milestones and some industry news and events. And I thought, let's start where we typically like to do with these ETF grab bags, as we call them,
turns.zh: 听着，巨人队现在并列分区第一，我就当这是一场胜利了。好了。我知道大家不是来听我们聊球的，而且我的观点大概率也不怎么样，那我们就上 ETF 观点吧。我知道我们今天要聊一堆近期 ETF 里程碑和行业新闻，我想，就按我们做这种'ETF 大杂烩'节目的惯例开始，

turns.en: which is inflows. Because I feel like those always set a nice backdrop for us to talk about everything else going on in the industry, especially over the past several years, right? Because it's been one record after another. But Todd, as we sit here today, guess what?
turns.zh: 先从资金流入说起。因为我总觉得这能为我们讨论行业里的一切定下一个很好的背景，尤其过去这几年，对吧？纪录一个接一个。但 Todd，就以今天的情况看，你猜怎么着？

turns.en: Inflows are nearing $1.5 trillion this year, which means they're set to break last year's record, which was right at $1.5 trillion. And we still have, what, over three months to go. So start by offering some perspective on this to get us rolling here.
turns.zh: 今年流入已经接近 1.5 万亿美元，意味着快要打破去年正好 1.5 万亿美元的纪录，而我们还有三个多月的时间。那先从这个话题开个头，给点你的看法。

turns.en: Yeah. So $1.5 trillion, we're actually at $1.43 trillion. I think the last time I took a closer look. So we could very well set a new record for overall flows by the end of September.
turns.zh: 嗯，1.5 万亿——据我上次仔细核对，实际是 1.43 万亿美元。所以九月底之前就很可能刷新总流量的纪录。

turns.en: And as you and many listeners know, the fourth quarter tends to be a stronger one for the ETF marketplace. As people position for the year ahead, they often use this as an opportunity to sell out of non-performing or non-performing as well mutual fund strategies. What's also caught my eye is we have set a record according to FACTSET data that we at VETIFY use. There is a record of fixed income flows this year. So we crossed $440 billion last week. That is now a new record for fixed income
turns.zh: 而且你和很多听众都知道，四季度往往是 ETF 市场更强的季度。大家为来年做布局的时候，常常趁机卖掉那些表现不佳的、不达预期的共同基金策略。还有一件让我注意的是，按照我们 VettaFi 用的 FACTSET 数据，今年固收流量创了纪录。上周我们已经突破 4400 亿美元，这是固收

turns.en: flows that beat last year. And you and I are talking the day that the Fed is going to announce if they're going to end up raising interest rates for the first time in a couple of years.
turns.zh: 流量的新纪录，超过了去年。而且你我今天聊天的这天，正好是美联储要宣布是否加息——可能是几年来第一次加息——的日子。

turns.en: Listeners will know that before you and I do at the moment. But that's just tremendous to see that fixed income demand has been so robust. I know fixed income tends to be boring. People are probably getting ready to fall asleep as I'm trying to do this with as much enthusiasm as possible. But ESCOV has led the charge. That's an ultra short bond ETF, VCIT, BND, IUSB, BNDX. Those are all $10 billion plus net inflow ETFs this year. So
turns.zh: 等你我搞清楚结果的时候，听众早就知道了。但看到固收需求这么旺盛，真的太棒了。我知道固收向来无聊，大家听我这段可能都快睡着了，我还得尽量讲得有热情一点。不过 ESCOV 一马当先，那是一只超短债 ETF；VCIT、BND、IUSB、BNDX，这些今年净流入都超过 100 亿美元。所以

turns.en: this has been a great year for fixed income ETFs already. Todd, I'm not falling asleep here and you know why I'm not falling asleep when we talk fixed income ETFs. Because who called this the year of fixed income ETFs back in early January? So you did. And I think this is going to be a recurring theme of this podcast. This random grab bag topics are going to cover many of the predictions that you had that are working out. But yes, you were correct. This has been a great
turns.zh: 今年已经是固收 ETF 的大年了。Todd，我可没睡着。你知道我们聊固收 ETF 我为什么不困吗？因为年初一月份，是谁喊出'固收 ETF 之年'的？是你。我想这会成为这期播客的一个贯穿主题：这些大杂烩话题，好多都会撞上你之前的预言成真。没错，你说对了，今年确实是固收 ETF 的

turns.en: year for fixed income ETFs. I will give you the first of many congratulations on getting this call right. Yeah. And I'll just offer a couple of other comments here just on ETF flows overall.
turns.zh: 好年份。关于你这次判断正确，我要送上接下来无数声祝贺中的第一声。——嗯，我再就 ETF 整体流量补充几点。

turns.en: I'll reiterate what you said and that, yeah, historically the fourth quarter tends to be the strongest for inflows. We know that. And so if we sit here today at $1.43 trillion, it seems like a layup that we're going to cross over $2 trillion, barring some huge setback in the market. And actually, if you look over the trailing one year, I give this stat occasionally, but trailing one year inflows are almost $2.1 trillion. And look in August, we just had a massive
turns.zh: 我重申你说的，历史上四季度确实是流入最强的，这个我们都知道。所以站在今天 1.43 万亿美元的位置，除非市场出现巨大挫折，突破 2 万亿美元应该十拿九稳。实际上，看过去滚动一年——这个数据我偶尔会提——过去十二个月的流入接近 2.1 万亿美元。而八月我们刚刚经历了巨大的

turns.en: about $180 billion in inflows. So the numbers are staggering. You were mentioning the fixed income ETFs. And I don't want to get too far in the weeds on individual ETF inflows this week, but I am curious as you look at the top of the ETF leaderboard. So let's say the top 25 or 50 ETFs, what are maybe two or three of the biggest stories you see here? What does the leaderboard tell you?
turns.zh: 一个月，流入大约 1800 亿美元。这些数字令人震撼。你刚才提到固收 ETF。这周我不想深挖单只 ETF 的流入，但我很好奇，你看 ETF 排行榜前列——比如前 25 或前 50——你会看到哪两三个最大的故事？榜单告诉了你什么？

turns.en: So what's interesting is three things that caught my eye. And even though you just said, let's not get in the weeds about individual ETFs, I do think that I'm going to use a couple of ETFs as examples. So one of the stories of the year to me was the long-awaited competition for the Qs from Invesco and QQQM. iShares and State Treat both launched lower cost products that was supposed to potentially have a negative effect on Invesco. QQQM has $22 billion of net inflows.
turns.zh: 有意思的是有三点吸引了我的注意。虽然你刚说别在单只 ETF 上钻牛角尖，我还是会拿几只 ETF 举例。对我而言，今年的一大故事，就是大家期待已久的、对 Invesco QQQ 的竞争：iShares 和 State Street 先后推出了更低成本的产品，本来可能对 Invesco 产生负面影响。而 QQQM 却有 220 亿美元的净流入。

turns.en: It is among the most popular ETFs. Now some of that has to do with the NASDAQ and people wanting exposure to the NASDAQ and they just go with what they are familiar with. But that's just impressive to me that we can see QQQM see strong inflows despite competition, where people obviously could sell out of that product to an iShares or a State Treat one. I didn't get the rules of the road. Do you want me to give you my two other ones or do you want to comment on the first one first?
turns.zh: 它是最受欢迎的 ETF 之一。当然，一部分原因是纳斯达克（NASDAQ），大家想要纳斯达克敞口，就直接买了自己熟悉的产品。但即便如此，看到 QQQM 在竞争下依然有强劲流入，我还是觉得很厉害——要知道大家明明可以卖掉它转投 iShares 或 State Street 的产品。我没接上咱们聊天的'规矩'。你要我继续讲另外两点，还是你先点评第一点？

turns.en: Yeah, let's do that. Why don't you throw out the other two and then we can bat them around a little bit. The second one also is Invesco related. RSP has $14 billion. Now again, I'm not trying to pick on or highlight an individual fund, but for years we, you and I were talking about the market needing to broaden out and people needing to believe that the market was going to broaden out.
turns.zh: 嗯，就这么办。你先把另外两个抛出来，然后我们再切磋切磋。——第二个也和 Invesco 有关。RSP 有 140 亿美元。再说一遍，我不是要针对或吹捧某一只基金，但这么多年，你我一直在说市场需要扩散，需要大家相信市场会扩散。

turns.en: No ETF is a better example of that than RSP, which is, if people don't know, that's the Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF. So all 500 companies, you get an equal weighting within the portfolio, roughly 0.2%. I say roughly because there's actually more than 500 stocks overall. And RSP is outperforming the market cap weighted S&P 500. So that just proves that those assets that went in have been appropriate. And then the third thing, sticking with that equity theme, has just been
turns.zh: 没有比 RSP 更好的例子了。大家如果不知道的话，它是 Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF（标普500等权重ETF）。500 家公司，组合里基本是等权配置，大约各占 0.2%。我说'大约'是因为实际上持股总数超过 500 只。而 RSP 跑赢了市值加权的标普 500。这就证明了，当初流进去的那些资金选对了。然后第三点，还是股票主题，就是

turns.en: active equity. And the fact that we have now three very strong flavors of products, and I don't know that you can have a strong flavor, but that's what I'm going with right now. So we have the more quantitative, low-cost, strategic-oriented Avontis suite of products. So AVLM and AVEM are two of the more popular products. That's a large cap, and I believe at large value.
turns.zh: 主动股票。我们现在有三种非常强势的'口味'——我不知道能不能说'强势的口味'，但我今天就这么说。第一种是更量化、低成本、策略导向的 Avantis 产品线。AVLM 和 AVEM 是其中比较受欢迎的两只。一只大盘，另一只我记得是大盘价值（large value）。

turns.en: And in the emerging markets from Avontis, that's part of the American Century family. We've got the more fundamental-oriented strategies. So CGDV, that's a capital group ETF, and DYNF, that's an iShares fundamental active product. And then we've got the options-based product. So JEPQ, which is a JP Morgan product, and QQQI, which is a Nios product soon to be owned by Goldman Sachs. So it's just interesting and exciting to me that ACTIV has continued to have
turns.zh: 以及来自 Avantis 的新兴市场产品——Avantis 是美国世纪资管（American Century）家族的一部分。第二种是更偏基本面的策略。CGDV，是 Capital Group 的 ETF；DYNF，是 iShares 的基本面主动产品。第三种是期权策略产品。JEPQ，摩根大通的；还有 QQQI，NEOS 的产品，马上就要被高盛（Goldman Sachs）收入麾下。所以对我来说，主动股票（active equity）持续

turns.en: a very good year, but it isn't just one of those subcategories or flavors that's doing very well. It's all three of them. I think those are three good stories. I don't have much to add on the ACTIV side. I think we've covered that pretty well. So I'll leave that one alone. I'll just add, you mentioned QQQM and how well it's done this year. And obviously, that's the established leader in the space on the low-cost side prior to those other products coming to market from State
turns.zh: 非常好的年份，而且不是三种子类别或'口味'里只有一种做得好，而是三种都做得好。我觉得这是三个不错的故事。——主动股票这块我没太多要补充的，我觉得我们已经聊得挺透了，这个就先放着。我就补一句，你提到 QQQM 今年表现很好。显然，在 State

turns.en: Street and iShares. And so it doesn't surprise me that it's still doing well. I will be interested to see longer term whether or not that market share erodes a little bit as the State Street and iShares products mature and gain some traction. On RSP, we've talked about this as well just with a broadening out of the market and people concerned about the top heaviness of market cap weighted indices and valuations and all those sorts of things. If I look at the ETF leaderboard,
turns.zh: Street 和 iShares 的产品上市之前，它就是低成本赛道上的既定领导者。所以它继续表现好，我并不意外。长期来看，我倒很想看看，随着 State Street 和 iShares 的产品逐渐成熟、获得一些客户认可，QQQM 的市场份额会不会被侵蚀一点。关于 RSP，我们也聊过，就是市场扩散，大家担心市值加权指数'头重脚轻'、担心估值，诸如此类。如果我看 ETF 排行榜，

turns.en: Todd, I'll sort of take the other side of RSP and that to me, it's clear investors are still piling into large cap US stocks that lean market cap weighted. Because if you look at the leaderboard, it's littered with all the usual suspects, right? Vu, SPI-M, VTI, which VTI is 75% large caps, QQQM is up there. It's all the usual suspects. And I just find that interesting because despite all of these purported concerns that people have put out there regarding the top heaviness of major
turns.zh: Todd，我其实要站到 RSP 的另一面。在我看来，投资者显然还是在涌入偏市值加权的美股大盘。因为你看榜单，全是那些老面孔，对吧？VOO、SPI-M、VTI——VTI 有 75% 是大盘——QQQM 也在榜上。全是老面孔。我就觉得有意思：尽管大家对外表达了那么多对主要指数

turns.en: indices and valuations and the stuff that I was mentioning earlier, ETF investors don't appear dissuaded. And we always say, you know, money talks, right? That where investors put their hard-earned dollars trumps any sort of market narrative and they're still piling into these market cap weighted indices. So while RSP is doing well, and there's some other examples of that, I think it bears mentioning even though everybody sees this that the top of the leaderboard is still the usual
turns.zh: 头重脚轻、估值高企的担忧，也就是我刚才说的那些，ETF 投资者看起来根本不为所动。我们老说，钱会说话，对吧？投资者把辛苦赚来的钱投到哪里，比任何市场叙事都管用——他们依然在涌入这些市值加权指数。所以虽然 RSP 表现不错，也有其他一些类似例子，但我想还是值得指出——虽然大家都看在眼里——榜单头部依然是那批老

turns.en: suspects. So yes, I agree. But part of why I think that's exciting, even though I agree with the points that you have as well, is that that to me is a sign that we're still in the early innings despite three decades being in this space, not you and I, but the ETF industry being available and they're being ETFs for people to invest in. Because most people who already have low cost S&P 500 exposure, they can of course be adding to it throughout the year. But the significant flows
turns.zh: 面孔。——对，我同意。但我觉得它令人兴奋的部分原因——虽然你说的点我也认同——是这在我看来说明我们仍处于早期阶段：不是你我，而是 ETF 行业已经存在三十年了，一直有 ETF 可以投。因为大多数人本来就有低成本标普 500 敞口，全年当然可以不断加仓。但我们看到的这些大规模流入，

turns.en: that we're seeing here to me is a sign that this is net new people who are coming into the space. And part of that was SPYM being chosen for people who want to have exposure to the S&P and the Trump accounts that are there. But many other people who are not using that that are just entering the ETF marketplace, entering by putting their own money to work into ETFs. That's just exciting. That means that this snowball has still has a lot of ground to pick up.
turns.zh: 对我来说是净新增人群正在进入这个市场的信号。其中一部分原因是 SPYM 被想要标普敞口的人选中了，还有那些'特朗普账户'（Trump accounts）。但还有很多不用那套的人，就是新进入 ETF 市场，直接把自己的钱放进 ETF。这太让人兴奋了。这说明雪球还有大把的路可以滚。

turns.en: Yeah, the question which I've asked us continually on the podcast and you could answer it if you want is does that leaderboard ever change because or is it always going to be the VOOs and the SPYM's depending upon tax loss harvesting and those sorts of things you get IVV in there, you know, does that ever change or is that just the status quo moving forward?
turns.zh: 对，这个问题我在节目里一直问，你想答就可以答：这个榜单到底会不会变？还是说永远是 VOO 和 SPYM 们？根据税务亏损收割（tax loss harvesting）之类的情况，IVV 也会进来。这个榜会不会变，还是就一直是这个格局？

turns.en: Well, again, I didn't because we spent enough time talking about it when it was a success story, but we are seeing funds periodically break out like DRAM is a perfect example of a fund that entered the marketplace. We didn't touch on it because I didn't know how much you'd want to talk about money market funds, but pro shares with their money market ETF is a new entrant and is showing up on the leaderboard. So there is still room for new firms to be among the most popular
turns.zh: 嗯，这个——因为这个成功故事我们已经聊得够多了——但我们确实会定期看到一些基金突围，DRAM 就是一个典型的例子，是新进入市场的基金。货币市场基金我们没怎么碰，因为我不知道你想聊多少——ProShares 的货币市场 ETF 是新入场者，已经登上榜单了。所以在最受欢迎的 ETF 行列里，依然留有给新公司的位置，

turns.en: ETFs, but low cost S&P 500 broad equity, broad fixed income products are still going to likely be towards the top of a leaderboard in up and down markets. All right. So that's flows. We continue to see these record inflows. Let's get to a few other stories here. So more than I was beforehand, respectfully, because I know of those people that have been brought in. I know Jeff Winniger more. I've worked with him when he was at Wisdom Tree, doing investor education. And I think bringing in ETF experts and people who can talk the ETF language will help. But let's get the let's just make sure the facts
turns.zh: 影响力很大。所以我很好奇，你怎么看这些人事动作？你现在整体怎么看 Corgi？你把他们当回事吗？——说实话，比以前更当回事了，恕我直言。因为这几位被请来的人里，我对 Jeff Wintinger 更熟，他在 WisdomTree 做投资者教育的时候我们就合作过。我觉得挖 ETF 专家、挖会说'ETF 这门语言'的人会有帮助。但先把事实摆清楚——

turns.en: and I'm not saying you were glossing over. They have more than half their assets in one ETF, their photonics related ETF. According to the data that I last saw, the other 193 ETFs have a combined 300 million in assets. Now, said most bluntly, it is hard to gather assets in the ETF industry. It is hard to gather assets in the ETF industry with new products. But they are coming to market with a lot of products. And right now the market is ignoring them. It's less that we in
turns.zh: 我不是说你刚才轻描淡写——他们一半以上的资产集中在一只 ETF 上，那只会光子（photonics）相关 ETF。按我上次看到的数，另外 193 只 ETF 加起来只有 3 亿美元资产。说得直白一点，ETF 行业募资就是难，靠新产品募资更难。他们确实在往市场推一大堆产品，但现在市场根本没搭理他们。与其说是我们这些评论人士

turns.en: the punditry aren't taking them serious is that investors haven't put money to work into them. So I think having experts like Jeff help tell the story of the ETFs and how they can fit in will likely increase their asset base and allow them to be taken more seriously instead of just launching products. And then let's see, I think that's extremely well said. I mean, to your point, they have launched nearly 200 ETFs this year. And you just gave the asset numbers. So they have a
turns.zh: 不把 Corgi 当回事，不如说是投资者还没往他们里面投钱。所以我觉得有 Jeff 这样的专家帮忙讲清楚 ETF 的故事、讲明白它们适合放在哪里，大概率能做大他们的资产底盘，让人真正把他们当回事，而不只是不停发产品。——我觉得这番话说得非常到位。正如你所言，他们今年发了将近 200 只 ETF。你也刚给了资产数字。所以他们要成功，

turns.en: long way to go here to be successful. A couple of things that I'll mention is they in general have entered these different ETF categories on the lower side from a price perspective, particularly in I think a category like leveraged ETFs, you know, they're really coming in and trying to compete on fees. But the problem that they're going to have to solve, which you were, I think, mentioning, is distribution. I was talking distribution earlier in the ETF dealmaking. Distribution
turns.zh: 还有很长的路要走。我要补充两点：他们进入各个 ETF 品类时，定价普遍偏低，特别是在杠杆 ETF 这类品类，他们是铁了心要靠费率抢市场。但他们要解决的大问题，我想你也提到了，是渠道。我前面聊并购时就说，渠道

turns.en: is king in the ETF space. And no matter how many products you put out on the market, I would say no matter how good those products are, if people don't know they exist, they're not familiar with a Corgi brand or whatever, it's going to be tough to get an audience. And so that to your point, bringing somebody like Jeff in and Aaron, you know, if they can get that visibility and start figuring out the distribution side, then, you know, this will work. I guess I'm just saying
turns.zh: 在 ETF 世界为王。无论你发多少产品——我想说，无论产品多好——如果大家不知道它们存在、不熟悉 Corgi 这个品牌，那要吸引眼球就难。所以正如你所说，把 Jeff、Aaron 这样的人请进来，如果能带来曝光、开始打通渠道，那这事就能成。我大概就是想表达，

turns.en: it's clear they're fully committed here. Like I don't think this is some fly by night operation where they're just launching a bunch of ETFs and say, well, let's see if it works. And if it doesn't, they go away. I think they're fully committed to building out an ETF business here, like a real longstanding business. Yeah, I mean, I don't disagree with that. And I think the hires just go full circle with the question, the hires make them more of a legitimate player within the space
turns.zh: 看得出来他们是全力以赴。我不觉得这是什么'打一枪换一个地方'、发一堆 ETF 试试看、不行就撤的草台班子。我觉得他们是要在这里建一个 ETF 业务，一个真正能基业长青的业务。——嗯，这点我不反对。我觉得这些招聘正好回应了那个问题：这些招聘让他们更像这个赛道里的正规军，

turns.en: than and so that when when you have a guest from Corgi, it's somebody who has that level of ETF knowledge, not somebody who's helped to develop the products and be part of the brand. And I'm not calling out the people who've who've spoken publicly. But the ETF language has a certain rhythm to it. And so I'm glad to see them bring in experts to be able to help.
turns.zh: 以后你请 Corgi 的嘉宾上节目，对方会是真有 ETF 功力的人，而不是参与开发产品、代言品牌的人。我没有点名任何公开发过声的朋友，但 ETF 这门语言是有它特定节奏的。很高兴看到他们请专家来助阵。

turns.en: Real quick, let's look ahead to the remainder of the year. And I wanted to do this because I was looking at our podcast schedule. I don't think you're back on here until like December. And so I felt like I had to put you on the spot to give us whatever you want to talk to three, four ETF stories you're watching the remainder of the year. So why don't you give me all the stories real quick? We'll have them on record. And then we can check back in on these when we chat again
turns.zh: 快速来一段年终展望。我之所以安排这个，是看了眼我们的节目排期。我印象中你下次来已经是 12 月左右了，所以我得当场点你，让你讲三四个下半年要盯的 ETF 故事。来，快速把故事都给我，我们先记录在案，等我们 12 月再聊的时候

turns.en: in December. Sure. So let me do two of them together first, if you want to respond to it, and then I'll squeeze in the third one if that if that's okay with you for it. The Fed likely to be raising interest rates later on today as you and I are recording this is likely to be supportive of value. But what I noticed is that not all value
turns.zh: 好回访。——行。那如果没问题的话，我先把两个合在一起说，你可以点评一下，然后我再塞进第三个。今年叙事的一部分是'价值股回来了'。我们看到一些价值策略跑赢了成长。美联储大概率就在你我录制这期节目的今天晚些时候加息，这通常利好价值。但我注意到，并非所有价值

turns.en: strategies are working. So the IWD, which is the ISHA's Russell 1000 value is actually crushing its Russell 1000 parent index by about 1000 basis points. The S&P 500 value strategy SPYV is the example of that is actually in line or slightly lagging the S&P 500. So value isn't value to everybody. And so the narrative is, will value have a great year? We'll go with it depends. So I'm interested to see one of that gap narrows. And then two, if that still is the value

turns.en: ahead of it, that is still prediction or thing I'm looking at one. And then the second one is international. We've seen international be more in demand international equity, that is VEA, which is the Vanguard Developed Markets ETF is crushing the S&P 500. But if you look at the ISHA's core MSCI EFA ETF, IEFA, it's in line because South Korea is in VEA, it's not in EI EFA product. And South Korea has been, if not still the best performing of those large developed
turns.zh: 领跑，那仍然是我在看的东西。第二个看点是国际市场。海外股票更受追捧了。国际发达股 VEA，也就是 Vanguard Developed Markets ETF，把标普 500 按在地上摩擦。但你看 iShares 的核心 MSCI EAFE ETF，也就是 IEFA，就跟标普持平，因为韩国在 VEA 里，不在 EAFE 这个产品里。韩国在那些大型发达/新兴市场里，就算不是现在，也一直是表现最好的之一——

turns.en: You want me to do the third one? Or do you want to comment on those top two? I'll chime in there real quick. So both of those are interesting value in international because they're both areas where investors have been burned by being allocated to them for quite a while.
turns.zh: 要我说第三个吗？还是你想先点评这两个？——我先插一句。这两个都很有意思，价值和国际，因为这两个领域，投资者因为配置它们吃了很久的亏了。

I agree with you if the environment changes that clearly that's going to be supportive of value. The other obvious lesson from your comments is to look under the hood, whether you're talking about a value ETF or international ETF. And I'll just mention to your point on like VEA and IEFA. It's the
turns.zh: 显然国际的故事变了，现在更多人相信这种表现是可以持续的。价值这边还得走着看。环境一旦变了，显然会利好价值，这一点我同意你。你这话带来的另一个明显的教训，就是不管你看价值 ETF 还是国际 ETF，都得'打开引擎盖'看底层。就你刚说 VEA 和 IEFA 这点，

turns.zh: 在新兴市场那边也一样，对吧？你看 iShares 的核心新兴市场 ETF IEMG，把 Vanguard 新兴市场 ETF VWO 打得落花流水。因为 IEMG 持有韩国而 VWO 没有。所以还是那句话，要清楚自己手里到底拿着什么。

turns.en: And in that case, I would also say be careful mixing different fund families when constructing parts of your portfolio. It's fine to do that. You just need to make sure to look under the hood.
turns.zh: 那种情况下我还会补一句：混搭不同基金公司的产品来搭建你的组合时要留个心眼。混搭本身没问题，只是务必要打开引擎盖看看。

turns.en: So that's all. I think both stories to watch through the end of the year. What else do you have? Awesome. So I don't want to comment on yours because I know you've got another guest coming up also. So the third story I'm just watching is ETF share classes. We came into the year with expectations. I think so did you. We had Verify and certainly you came into the year with expectations that we would see the first and perhaps some ETF share classes. The industry has taken a very
turns.zh: 好，这两个我都记下了，都是年底前值得盯的故事。你还有什么？——第三个我就不点评你的了，因为我知道你下一位嘉宾也快了。我盯的第三个故事是 ETF 份额（ETF share classes）。年初我们都抱着预期——我想你也是——我们 VettaFi，还有你，都预期我们会看到首批 ETF 份额，可能还不止一两个。但整个行业推进得非常

turns.en: gradual pace. We've got Dimensional and Thornburg and Fidelity and Hotzgeson Wireless and Nuvine. turns.zh: 慢。我记得的就有 Dimensional、Thornburg、Fidelity、Hotzgeson Wireless 和 Nuveen 这五家推出了 ETF 份额。另外还有 90 家已经获批或接近获批。他们在等什么？

turns.en: Are they going to come to market? I know what they're waiting for. They're waiting to see if it works and if there is investor demand for it. But are they going to between now and the end of the year will we see double digit firms that have offered the share class so that they have a starting in 2027 a track record? We tend to see things happen in December for that reason. So I'm watching whether or not we can get to double digit firms, which is a very low bar to cross.
turns.zh: 他们会进场吗？我知道他们在等什么。他们在等这条路走不走得通，有没有投资者需求。但从现在到年底，我们会看到两位数的公司推出这种份额，让它们从 2027 年开始就有一段业绩记录吗？我们常常看到这类事在 12 月扎堆发生。所以我盯着的是能不能到两位数的公司——这是个非常低的门槛。

turns.en: I think yes. I think we will see more than 10 firms that have entered in 2026. What are you? Well, a couple of things here. Number one, we've been talking about all my successful ETF predictions, which I appreciate. I will give you credit on this one because I can remember talking about the ETF share class story way back when and if I recall correctly, you were all over this and that you thought maybe it was being overhyped. Maybe overhyped isn't the right word,
turns.zh: 我觉得会。进场的公司会超过 10 家。你怎么看？——嗯，说几点。第一，我们一直在聊我的那些'神预言'，谢谢你抬举。这一条我得给你记一功：很早之前聊 ETF 份额这个话题的时候，我记得你当时对这件事非常上心，觉得它可能有点被过度炒作。也许'过度炒作'不是准确的词，

turns.en: but just that the actual rollout would be slow. So I'll give you credit on that because you were right. I think a lot of people in the industry and I'm not going to rewrite history. I think I was largely very positive on this. You were a little more conservative. I think you hit the nail on the head and a lot of them seem like they're in a wait-and-see mode as to how much can this actually move the needle. You've had some of the larger firms, the dimensionals roll this out, but
turns.zh: 但你的意思是实际铺开会很慢。这一点你说对了，算你一功。我想行业里很多人——我也不改写历史——我一开始其实相当乐观，你更保守一点。现在看你说中了要害：很多公司确实是在观望，看这事到底能撬动多大分量。你看到一些大公司，比如 Dimensional 们，把它推出来了，

turns.en: it just doesn't make sense for everybody. We always say regardless of what the wrapper is that you have it in, it's not automatically going to solve problems like distribution or performance or those sorts of things. So the ETF share class, well, I think it's positive for the industry for sure. It's not automatically going to turn an issuer into a success. So I think we'll get to that 10 number, but this is going a lot more at a slower pace than I anticipated.
turns.zh: 但这事不是对每个人都划算。我们一直说，不管你用什么包装（wrapper），它不会自动解决渠道、业绩这类问题。所以 ETF 份额，我肯定它对整个行业是好事，但它不会自动把发行商变成赢家。我觉得两位数这个数我们最终会到，但推进的节奏比我预期的慢太多了。

turns.en: Well, I appreciate the compliment. What do we have? We had three things that you got right. It's only fair that I got one of them. That's right. Well, Todd, fun chat is always great stuff.
turns.zh: 谢谢夸奖。咱们算算账：你说对了三条，我要是一条都对不上的话，那多不公平——得，这条算我也蒙对了一个。没错。好了 Todd，每次和你聊天都很过瘾。

turns.zh: 谢谢你本周来做客。——谢谢你。也谢谢各位听众。刚才这位是 VettaFi 研究主管 Todd Rosenbluth。

turns.zh: 接下来和我一起的是 Westwood Holdings Group CEO Brian Casey。Westwood 目前旗下有三只 ETF、近 5 亿美元资产，明天他们将正式推出第四只 ETF——Westwood Salient Enhanced Power and Infrastructure ETF，代码 PWRX，简称 PowerX。

turns.zh: 这只 ETF 值得关注的地方，除了它的投资思路——这个我们当然要细聊——还在于它是第一只在全新的德州证券交易所上市的 ETF。

turns.en: And so we'll find out from Brian all of the decision making that went into that. He's now joining me from Dallas. Brian, it is a pleasure to connect. Welcome to the podcast.
turns.zh: 所以 Brian 会跟我们讲这个决定背后的全部考量。他现在从达拉斯连线。Brian，很高兴连上你，欢迎来节目。

turns.en: Nate, it's great to be here. All right. So there is a lot that we are going to discuss between Westwood's ETF business, certainly this new PowerX ETF, launching and listing on the Texas Stock Exchange.
turns.zh: Nate，我也很高兴来到这里。——好，我们要聊的很多：Westwood 的 ETF 业务，当然还有这只新 PowerX ETF 在德州证券交易所发行和上市的事。

Sure. Well, we're an asset management and wealth management business. We collectively manage about $18 billion and we've been in business for 43 years. So we've been doing this a long time and we have both a great mix of institutional investors along with lots of advisors and some
turns.zh: 但我想先聊公司本身。Westwood 是上市公司，你担任 CEO 已经二十多年了。给我们做个介绍吧，你想怎么描述这家公司？——嗯，我们是一家资产管理和财富管理公司，合计管理约 180 亿美元资产，成立 43 年了，算是久经此道。我们的客户构成很均衡，既有大量机构客户，也有许多投顾，还有一些

And I've had just about every job in the firm. So I have, I think, a pretty good perspective on what people face every
turns.zh: 私人财富客户。——你的个人背景呢？我刚才也提了，你在这个 CEO 位子上二十多年了，讲讲你的经历吧。——好啊。我大学毕业后先是做理财规划师，然后去一家信托公司干了大约七年，之后就来了 Westwood。我在 Westwood 已经 34 年了，所以是一段很长的旅程。公司里几乎每个岗位我都干过，所以我想我对大家每天面对什么

turns.en: day. And what I feel like my main role is really to foster the culture that we've developed over a really long time. We've been recognized as the best places to work by P&I now for 11 years in a row.
turns.zh: 还算有发言权。我觉得我自己的核心角色，是呵护我们这么多年沉淀下来的文化。我们已经连续 11 年被 P&I 评为最佳雇主。

turns.en: And, you know, that really takes some work. It takes a lot of time and effort. And, you know, we really cherish our people. We support our people. We really want to be a place where people want to come to work and they want to stay here. And so I have lots of people I've worked with for two or three decades. Okay. So tomorrow, your firm is launching a brand new ETF. Again, the Westwood Salient Enhanced Power and Infrastructure ETF, ticker PowerX. And what is noteworthy here is
turns.zh: 你知道，这真得下功夫，要投入大量的时间和精力。我们非常珍惜员工、支持员工。我们就是想成为一个大家愿意来、也愿意留下来的地方。所以我身边有很多共事二三十年的老战友。——好。明天你们要推出一只全新 ETF，就是 Westwood Salient Enhanced Power and Infrastructure ETF，代码 PowerX。值得关注的地方在于，

turns.en: this will be the first ETF to actually launch on the Texas Stock Exchange. Now, I have several questions around that, but I always like to cover the basics on this podcast. And so first, if you don't mind, I'd love to have you just explain what it means for an ETF to launch and list on a particular venue. Like what exactly are exchanges providing? Most people think about what the ETF is more than they think about where it's where it's listed. In fact, I bet if we asked our
turns.zh: 它将是第一只在德州证券交易所上市的 ETF。关于这个我有好几个问题，但我这个节目习惯先把基础讲清楚。所以，如果你不介意的话，先请你讲讲，一只 ETF 在某家交易所发行并上市，到底意味着什么？交易所究竟在提供什么？大多数人关心 ETF 是什么，而不是它在哪里上市。我打赌，要是我们问我们三只 ETF 的现有客户，

turns.en: current clients within our three ETFs that we have, where it's listed, I'm not sure they would know. They might know the ticker, but you've had a duopoly in New York with both the New York Stock Exchange and NASDAQ now for a really long time. And so the entrant of Texas Stock Exchange into the mix I think helps provide a better price discovery and more liquidity for investors.
turns.zh: 它在哪里上市，他们可能都答不上来，顶多知道个代码。而纽约长期以来是'双寡头'格局——纽交所和纳斯达克。德州证券交易所的入场，我认为有助于为投资者提供更好的价格发现（price discovery）和更多流动性。

turns.en: They also have a market making component that's a little different than the other two. You as a issuer can choose one of three different options from a market making perspective. And that can be very helpful to you, particularly when you're launching a new ETF. If you want a really experienced person as your market maker, you pay a little bit extra and you can have that.
turns.zh: 他们在做市商（market making）机制上也和前两家不太一样。作为发行方，你在做市方面可以从三种方案里选一种。这在推出新 ETF 时尤其有用——如果你想要一位真正资深的做市商，多付一点钱，就可以安排。

turns.en: And that's what we love about the Texas Stock Exchange. Talk more about the particular decision to list on any venue. In other words, is you're evaluating different venues? What are the services you're looking at? What are the bells and whistles?
turns.zh: 这就是我们喜欢德州证券交易所的地方。——再多讲讲选择上市场所的决策本身。你们是在比较不同交易所吗？你们在看哪些服务？有哪些'花样'？如果要排座次，靠什么把一家交易所排在前面？

turns.en: What puts one exchange in front of the other if you're making that decision? Yeah, I think there's very little difference to the investor. And for us as an issuer, there's not a ton of difference either. It's really about trying to experiment and find what is ultimately the best home for all of our ETFs. And none of us have been at this very long. It's been 2019 since active ETFs have really been going full steam. So you got about four
turns.zh: ——嗯，我觉得对投资者来说差别很小。对我们发行方来说，差别也没多大。这更多是一种尝试，寻找我们所有 ETF 最终的'最佳归宿'。而且我们所有人干这个都没多久——主动 ETF 从 2019 年才真正全速前进。所以你现在大概有四种选择，

turns.en: choices and we're going to try three of them. And let's talk a year from now and I'll have a better perspective on whether one's better than the other. But for right now, we're just excited to launch PowerX on the Texas Stock Exchange because it really aligns with our Texas roots.
turns.zh: 我们要先试三种。一年之后再聊，我就能对谁更好有更清晰的判断了。但眼下，我们很高兴把 PowerX 放在德州证券交易所首发，因为它和我们的德州根基真正契合。

turns.en: And it is all about what is happening all around us. I mean, Texas is absolutely booming. The data center build out despite all the recent controversy continues with great abandon. And it is not going to stop. It may slow down. But all of the power that is going to be needed to fuel all these things is going to have to be built. And the idea behind PowerX is that we are in a secular growth trend in our view. All the cyclical stuff has already been discovered. The chips,
turns.zh: 这一切也和我们就在身边发生的事有关。我是说，德州简直是在爆发。数据中心建设，尽管最近争议不断，仍然在狂热推进，而且不会停。也许慢一点。但要给这一切供电，就必须把电力设施建出来。PowerX 背后的理念是：在我们看来，这是一个长期的结构性增长趋势（secular growth trend）。周期性的东西已经被市场充分挖掘了——芯片、

turns.en: the hyperscalers, all of those stocks have had tremendous runs over the last few years. But the things that really are behind it, which would be natural gas, utilities, solar, wind, big gas, turbines, servers, and then the companies and people that put all this stuff together, that's a 10-year build. And we want to participate in that. And like all of our ETFs, one of the things that we do is we write covered calls on about half the portfolio. So while you're on this
turns.zh: 超大规模云厂商（hyperscalers），这些股票过去几年已经涨了太多。但真正在背后的东西——天然气、公用事业、光伏、风电、大型燃气轮机、服务器，以及把所有这些东西拼装起来的公司和人——这是一场十年的建设周期。我们想参与其中。和我们所有 ETF 一样，我们做的事情之一是对大约一半的组合卖出备兑看涨期权（covered calls）。所以在这条

turns.en: 10-year journey, you're getting paid roughly 5% yield, which is great. I want to get further into that ETF here in a moment. But before we move on from just talking about taxi, I'd love to have you offer some more context here just in terms of the bigger picture.
turns.zh: 十年征途上，你大约能拿到 5% 的收益率，这很棒。——一会儿我想再深入聊这只 ETF。但在离开 TSE 话题之前，想请你再讲讲更大的背景。

turns.en: And I'm curious what you think it means for the ETF industry to have another listing venue. And I would say, I think you would agree, obviously competition is always good.
turns.zh: 我很好奇，你觉得 ETF 行业多一个上市交易场所意味着什么。我想你会同意：竞争当然是好事。

turns.en: So is it that simple or are there other potential impacts here? Well, I think what's happening is that there's been a combination of both a lot of intentional support from really the governmental entities in Austin, particularly the governor and the Senate and the House, to try to make Texas a really easy business, easy state to do business in. And they've done that in a number of ways.
turns.zh: 就这么简单，还是会有其他潜在影响？——嗯，我认为眼下发生的事情，是奥斯汀的政府力量——特别是州长、州参议院和州众议院——有意为之的大量支持共同促成的。他们想让德州成为一个真正容易做生意的州，而且在很多方面都做到了。

turns.en: One is they've made it very easy to incorporate here. They have beefed up the business courts so we can compete with Delaware. We are trying to make this an easy and inexpensive place to do business. And we have no state income tax. And what you're seeing is people leaving a lot of states that would traditionally maybe have landed some of these projects and they're coming to Texas.
turns.zh: 一是他们让在这里注册公司非常容易。他们加强了商事法庭，让我们可以和特拉华竞争。我们想打造一个省事、低成本的营商环境，而且我们没有州所得税。你看到的现象是，人们正在离开很多传统上会拿到这些项目的州，纷纷搬来德州。

turns.en: And so the idea of having an exchange here is really it aligns with all of those positive things that are happening. And as you said, price discovery, competition, lower prices for the investor, all of those things are what we're all aiming for. And I think to your point, I know there's also now Nizee, Texas, there's Nasdaq, Texas. Is that just further indication of the state's growing prominence as a financial hub? Yeah, well, I think it's not an accident.
turns.zh: 所以在这里开一家交易所的主意，正好和所有正在发生的积极因素同频。正如你说的，价格发现、竞争、给投资者更低的价格，这些都是我们追求的目标。——另外我理解，现在还有 NYSE Texas、Nasdaq Texas 这些安排。这是不是也进一步说明德州作为金融中心的地位在上升？——嗯，我认为这不是偶然。

turns.en: They're not symbolic bets. They're economic bets. And we have NYSE, Texas is about a driver, five iron from here, and Nasdaq's a little further away. But they're all right down here in this economic miracle that is happening here in Dallas, Texas. It's just incredible as I look out my window. I've been, we've been in the Crescent, which is a iconic building in Dallas.
turns.zh: 它们不是象征性的下注，而是经济账。NYSE Texas 离这里大概就一刻钟车程，Nasdaq 稍远一点。但它们都扎在这里——达拉斯正在上演经济奇迹。我坐在窗边看着窗外，简直不可思议。我们所在的 The Crescent 是达拉斯一栋标志性建筑。

turns.en: We've been in it for 36 years now. And I still got my window and see nothing. And now I see nothing but cranes. So there is just building going on everywhere. Goldman Sachs has got a campus coming out of the ground that's going to house 5,000 people. Morgan Stanley just brought the dirt right in front of us for one, they're going to put a $1.3 billion tower up. JP Morgan has more financial services professionals in Texas than they do in New York.
turns.zh: 我们已经在这里待了 36 年。以前我从这个窗户看出去什么都没有，现在看到的只有塔吊。到处都在施工。高盛正在拔地而起一个园区，能容纳 5000 人。摩根士丹利就在我们正前方拿下土地，准备盖一栋 13 亿美元的塔楼。摩根大通在德州的金融服务从业人员比在纽约还多。

turns.en: All the Canadian banks have moved here. So, you know, it is, it is exactly aligned with what's happening in Texas is what's happening in Dallas and why people want to be here. It's an economic reason. Okay, so if we come back to the ETF, you gave us a brief preview, but again, the Westwood Salient Enhanced Power and Infrastructure ETF. Tell us more about that particular product. Is an investor or an advisor digs into this? What exactly are they going to find? Talk about the
turns.zh: 所有加拿大的大银行都搬来了。所以，德州正在发生的事，就是达拉斯正在发生的事，也是大家想留在这里的原因。这是一笔经济账。——好，我们回到 ETF。你刚才给了个预告片，就是这个 Westwood Salient Enhanced Power and Infrastructure ETF。跟我们多讲讲这只产品。如果有投资者或者投顾扒开细看，他们到底会看到什么？聊聊

turns.en: investment strategy here. Sure. So, again, and I'm sorry to jump into that, maybe got ahead of myself with your question, but we are super excited about it. And we've got the launch here tomorrow as the first ETF to list on the Texas Stock Exchange. And we're ringing the bell here in our office in the morning and again in the afternoon, and we've got a big event planned.
turns.zh: 投资策略吧。——好，抱歉，我可能抢在你问题前面了，但我们对这只产品真的超级兴奋。明天它作为德州证券交易所首只上市 ETF 首发。早上我们在办公室里敲钟，下午再敲一次，还安排了一场大活动。

turns.en: So, we're super excited about it. And I think, you know, every successful ETF begins with a problem that you're trying to solve. And we think investors are looking for companies that have durable competitive advantages, strong free cash flow generation, pricing power, and the ability to compound value over time. And as I said earlier, this secular build out is a minimum of 10 years.
turns.zh: 所以我们真的非常兴奋。我认为，每一只成功的 ETF，都始于你想解决的某个问题。我们相信投资者在寻找这样一些公司：有持久的竞争优势、强劲的现金流生成能力、定价权，以及随时间复利增值的能力。正如我之前说的，这一轮结构性建设最少是十年。

turns.en: So, just to fuel the stuff that we have now, we need 4 gigawatts of power by 2030. There's 2000 gigawatts of power waiting in line to get power. And, you know, and that is, that's going to take 10 plus years to build all that out. And so, the companies that do all those things, these are, you know, these are not who can build the fastest chip. These are the things, if you drop them on your foot, you break your leg. I mean, this is, this is picks and shovels. This is, you know,
turns.zh: 光是为我们现有的这些设施供电，到 2030 年就需要 4 吉瓦（gigawatt）的电力。还有 2000 吉瓦的负荷在排队等供电。这些全部建出来需要十年以上。而干这些事的公司，比拼的不是'谁能造最快的芯片'。这些东西——举起来掉你脚上能把腿砸断的那种。我的意思是，这是'镐和铲'（picks and shovels）生意，

turns.en: all the stuff that goes into actually building these things. And it requires engineering, it requires skilled labor. You know, it requires big gas turbines in some cases. You know, they got to figure out what to do with water. They're coming out with closed loop systems now so that they can not be such water hogs, which is what some of the folks in Texas are calling them.
turns.zh: 是真正把东西建起来所需的一切。它需要工程，需要熟练工人。有些环节需要大型燃气轮机。还得想办法处理水——他们现在推出闭环（closed loop）冷却系统，就是为了别那么'喝水'，德州有人就是这么吐槽它们的。

turns.en: So, we want to own all of those things that go into power generation. And there'll be other managers that can do, you know, pick whether in video or, you know, the hyperscalers, whether they're, you know, one's better than the other. That's not what we're doing. What we're doing is we are all about the power generation side of things. And, and you get paid for your patients while you're in this, what we think is a secular build out by getting some yield. And we pay that
turns.zh: 所以我们想拥有所有参与发电的环节。会有别的基金经理去挑 Nvidia、挑超大规模云厂商，说谁比谁强——那不是我们在做的事。我们做的，全心全意是发电这一侧。而且在我们看来，这场结构性建设的漫长征途里，你的耐心会换来收益（yield），我们按月支付

turns.en: yield monthly. So, it's around 5%. That's our target. And when we launched all of our ETFs, we found that clients really like to have a monthly income. And so, all of our ETFs provide that.
turns.zh: 这笔收益，目标是 5% 上下。我们每发一只 ETF 都发现，客户真的很喜欢月度现金流。所以我们的所有 ETF 都提供月度收益。

turns.en: And, and that has been, that's proven to be a real positive, we've had a real positive reaction from people from that. As you mentioned earlier, the way that you're generating some of that income is through this covered call strategy, this overlay. Talk more about that. And, and I guess I'd love to have you frame, you know, if there's high conviction around this build out, this energy build out, if you're utilizing a covered call strategy, obviously you're giving away a little
turns.zh: 而这一点确实带来了实实在在的好处，我们收到的反馈非常正面。——正如你之前提到的，你产生部分收益的方式是备兑开仓策略，就是这个期权'贴片'（overlay）。多讲讲。我还有个问题想请你框定一下：如果你们对这波能源建设如此高确信，却用备兑开仓策略，那显然是让渡了一部分上行空间。

turns.en: bit of your upside there. And so, how do you think about that? Well, that's really up to the portfolio management team. They're going to write calls that are, you know, six, eight, 10% out of the money. And, you know, so you do pick up that level of upside. We're not going to write them on the entire portfolio. We'll write them on about half the portfolio. And there'll be things in the portfolio that are less volatile. There'll be some utilities. There'll be some natural gas.
turns.zh: 这个账你们怎么想？——嗯，这其实由投资组合管理团队决定。他们会卖出虚值 6%、8%、10% 的看涨期权，所以那部分上行空间你还是保得住的。我们不会对整个组合开仓，只对大约一半。组合里会有波动小一些的东西，比如一些公用事业，一些天然气。

turns.en: There'll be some things that, you know, don't move around quite as much. And then we'll have some really exciting names in the portfolio that we think are, you know, that are just true growth stories. You know, if you, if you want a big gas turbine and you order one from GE Veranova today, you'd be lucky to get it by 2030. I mean, there's, and there's just not anybody else that owns them. So, you know, that builds them. So it's a, it is a really impactful, I think, portfolio
turns.zh: 也会有'不那么上蹿下跳'的品种。然后组合里还会有一些真正让人兴奋的持仓，我们觉得是纯粹的成长故事。比如你要一台大型燃气轮机，今天向 GE Vernova 下单，能在 2030 年之前拿到就烧高香了。我的意思是，别人手里根本没有产能——只有他们在造。所以我认为这是一个真正有分量的

turns.en: of companies. And so we're, we're, couldn't be more excited about it. This is an actively managed strategy. Mine are standing. This is managed by Westwood's Houston based energy team. Why do you think active management is important in this arena? Well, you know, things have been flow over time.
turns.zh: 公司组合。我们对此再兴奋不过了。——这是一只主动管理策略的 ETF，由 Westwood 休斯顿的能源团队管理。你为什么认为主动管理在这个领域很重要？——嗯，情况会随时间变化。

turns.en: And, you know, that happens from both political pressures and changes in technology. So you want to be on top of both of those things. So if, you know, if we put a halt on data center development in Texas, which I don't think we'll do, but, you know, some people are pushing, you know, pushing for a slowdown, no, that's something you got to pay attention to. And, you know, as technologies evolve and develop, like I talked about the closed loop water systems, you know, they didn't have that
turns.zh: 政治压力和技术的变化都会起作用，所以这两样你都要跟得住。比如，假如德州叫停数据中心建设——我不认为真会这样——但确实有人推动放缓，那你就得紧盯。技术在演进，就像我说的闭环水系统，几年前还没有，

turns.en: a few years ago. Now they have it. And they're going to, that's going to continue to get better. And we want to own the people that are building those things that, that are getting better. And so we've been managing money now for 43 years. And, and we think we bring a lot to the table in terms of experience, and especially being in Texas, as long as we have, we think we've got a little bit of an edge there. In terms of the risk to this category, I think you touched on one that is
turns.zh: 现在有了，而且还会越做越好。我们想拥有那些造出更好东西的公司。我们做资产管理已经 43 年，在经验上我们自认为能带来很多东西，尤其我们扎根德州这么久，我觉得多少有一点近水楼台的优势。——聊到这个品类的风险，你刚才提到的一个，我觉得现在非常突出。

turns.en: certainly prominent now. And really it's two, you have sort of this political angle and how politicians are going to handle the continued build out of AI infrastructure. And I think that also gets into the community engagement aspect where you have some communities perhaps pushing back on data centers. How do you think about that as a risk? I mean, everybody knows the AI story itself, that's not going anywhere. But it does seem like there's a lot more consternation.
turns.zh: 其实是两件事：一个是政治角度，政客们会如何应对 AI 基础设施的持续建设；我觉得这里头还有社区沟通的问题，有些社区在抵制数据中心。你怎么把这件事当作风险来考量？我的意思是，AI 的故事谁都知道，它不会消失。但大家围绕 AI 建设的焦虑显然多了很多。

turns.en: And maybe that's just been politically driven, but there's a lot more consternation around the AI build out. So how do you think about that as a risk to this particular strategy?
turns.zh: 也许这多少是政治因素驱动的，但围绕 AI 扩建的不安确实多了很多。那你怎么看它作为这套具体策略的风险？

turns.en: Well, I have a very good friend who's the CEO of a data center company. And he will be the first one to tell me what a terrible job that his industry has done of explaining to the world what it is they're trying to do. And they've got to become better communicators, more open communicators are going to have to engage more with the cities that they want to build these centers in. And they really need to help people understand just, you know, how do they benefit
turns.zh: 嗯，我有个非常好的朋友，是一家数据中心的 CEO。他会第一时间告诉我：他们这个行业在'向全世界解释自己在干什么'这件事上做得有多糟糕。他们必须成为更好的沟通者、更开放的沟通者，必须和他们想建数据中心的城市更多互动。他们真的需要让大家明白，你们到底

turns.en: from that? I think people are very skeptical, right? They think this is all about, you know, building out for Microsoft and AWS and all the big hyperscalers. And that's all it is. Well, it's a lot more than that. You know, it's a lot of really positive things that can come from all of this. You know, the ability that AI has to solve so many health care problems is going to be absolutely amazing to watch over the next five years. And I think the debate that they're having
turns.zh: 能从中得到什么好处？我觉得人们是很怀疑的，对吧？大家以为这都是给 Microsoft、AWS 还有那些超大规模云厂商'盖房子'，仅此而已。但事情远不止于此。这一切能带来很多真正积极的东西。你知道 AI 解决医疗问题的潜力吗？未来五年会精彩到让人瞠目。我觉得他们现在正在进行的关于给 AI 设护栏的讨论——我记得 Elon Musk 昨天还评论，

turns.en: right now about putting some guardrails around AI, and I thought Elon Musk commented yesterday, where, you know, why don't we have everybody grade each other's homework, right? Like, let's look at yours, you look at mine, and we'll compare notes. And maybe, you know, somehow there's a way in here where we can figure out that, you know, we're not going to be extinguished in 10 years, as, you know, some of the folks are worried about right now. But it's, you know, it's
turns.zh: 大概意思是我们何不互相批改作业，对吧？你的给我看，我的给你看，大家对照一下。也许这里面能找到某种办法，确保我们不会像现在有些人担心的那样'十年内被灭绝'。但这是令人惊叹的新技术。我们确实需要它，确实得继续建这些东西。但我们必须把'为什么需要它们'这件事讲得更好，

turns.en: incredible new technology. We do need it. We do need to keep building these things. But we have to get better at the message around why we need them. And we have to get better about, you know, making sure that we have the kind of guardrails that we would need, you know, to keep this thing from getting out of control. Any thoughts on nuclear energy? Because that also obviously generates a lot of buzz and some consternation. And my understanding, correct me if I'm wrong,
turns.zh: 也必须建立起真正需要的护栏，防止这事失控。——那对核电有什么想法？因为核电显然也是话题与争议并存。据我理解——说错了纠正我——PowerX 组合里更多的是传统能源。你怎么看核电？——嗯，这确实是我们正在关注的事。技术演进到

turns.en: in the PowerX portfolio, it's much more traditional energy. What are your thoughts on nuclear? Yeah, I mean, it's definitely something that we're looking at. Certainly the, you know, the technology is evolving to the point where, you know, you don't have to build a three-mile island-type project to be able to generate nuclear power. As our former president used to say, nuclear power.
turns.zh: 今天，你已经不需要建一座'三里岛'那种规模的工程才能发核电了。正如我们前总统常说的——'核能'。

turns.en: But, you know, it is a smaller version of that. And that is really becoming, I think, more mainstream. And definitely something we're on top of and we're paying attention to. I wouldn't say it will never be in our portfolio. It's probably a little overdone at the moment. It's more expensive, just as I mentioned, the chips. I mean, for those that owned it video the last 10 years, good for you. That was an unbelievable call. But, you know, I've been doing this for 40
turns.zh: 但那是同一种东西的缩小版，我觉得它正在真正走向主流。这确实是我们紧跟、关注的方向。我不会说它永远进不了我们的组合。它现在可能有点被炒过头了，估值更贵，就像我刚说的芯片。过去十年持有 Nvidia 的朋友，恭喜你，那是个令人难以置信的神预测。但我干这行 40

turns.zh: 在我们认为被低估和被高估的板块之间切换。至于和 Salient 的合作，那是我们几年前萌生的一个有意思的想法。我们和业内一位先驱合作，他有一个理念：波动率可以是你的朋友，也可以是敌人。波动率高企时，通常是你想降低市场敞口的时候；波动率低时，恰恰是你想

turns.en: want to be more exposed to the market. And so, we have a mathematically sound approach to increasing exposure when volatility is low and decreasing exposure when volatility is high. turns.zh: 加大市场敞口的时候。所以我们有一套数学上站得住的方法，波动率低时提高敞口，高时降低敞口。我们手里有两只：DVSP，字面意义上就是把 SPY 拿来，用这个数学公式在波动率低时'踩油门'，高时'松油门'。
